<!-- creating custom music player -->
<div style="max-width: 380px; margin: 30px auto; background: #1e1e2e; border-radius: 20px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); color: white; font-family: monospace;">

  <!-- showing song info -->
  <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom: 16px;">

  </div>

  <!-- showing progress bar -->
  <div style="background:#333; border-radius: 999px; height: 6px; margin: 16px 0; cursor:pointer;" onclick="seekSong(event, this)">
    <div id="progress-bar" style="background: linear-gradient(90deg, #a78bfa, #ec4899); width: 0%; height: 100%; border-radius: 999px;"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- showing time -->
  <div style="display:flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size:0.75em; color:#888;">
    <span id="current-time">0:00</span>
    <span>3:33</span>
  </div>

  <!-- showing control buttons -->
  <div style="display:flex; justify-content:center; gap: 24px;">
    <button onclick="restartSong()">⏮</button>
    <button id="play-btn" onclick="togglePlay()">▶</button>
    <button onclick="muteSong()" id="mute-btn">🔊</button>
  </div>

</div>

<script>
  // initializing player state
  var player;
  var isPlaying = false;
  var isMuted = false;

  // loading youtube api
  var tag = document.createElement('script');
  tag.src = "https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api";
  document.head.appendChild(tag);

  // creating player
  function onYouTubeIframeAPIReady() {
    player = new YT.Player('yt-player');
  }

  // toggling play and pause
  function togglePlay() {
    if (!player) return;
    if (isPlaying) {
      player.pauseVideo();
      isPlaying = false;
    } else {
      player.playVideo();
      isPlaying = true;
    }
  }

  // restarting song
  function restartSong() {
    if (!player) return;
    player.seekTo(0);
    player.playVideo();
  }

  // muting and unmuting
  function muteSong() {
    if (!player) return;
    if (isMuted) {
      player.unMute();
      isMuted = false;
    } else {
      player.mute();
      isMuted = true;
    }
  }
</script>
